Show the bird board on a TV

The site can prepare a full-screen display, but the browser controls casting to your TV.

  1. On a Samsung phone, swipe down twice and tap Smart View or Cast, then select your TV.
  2. On a computer with Chrome, open the ⋮ menu, choose Cast, then select your TV and cast this tab.

Make sure your phone or computer and TV are on the same Wi‑Fi network.
